customer_name: The Walton Centre NHS Foundation Trust
business_problem: The Walton Centre faced long waits and inefficient headache referral intake because clinicians spent large portions of first appointments collecting basic history manually, delaying treatment and making it hard to triage urgent cases quickly enough.
solution_summary: The Walton Centre and TCS implemented a website-based conversational AI service to move headache triage and history collection upstream of the first specialist appointment. Patients use the AI chatbot to answer clinician-authored structured questions and provide additional details in natural conversation, while the service captures the response flow as a structured patient summary. TCS built the solution with AWS support and connected the output directly to the trust's electronic medical record system so consultants can review symptoms, history, and red flags before the first face-to-face visit. That architecture lets the trust standardize data capture, keep records secure, and reduce paper-based handling while giving clinicians a governed digital intake process that can identify severe cases earlier and shorten time spent on administrative questioning during appointments.

solution_components.name: AI chatbot
solution_components.role: Conducts the conversational intake flow for headache patients and captures structured and natural-language answers.

solution_components.role: Provides the cloud foundation for the chatbot service that the trust runs on its website.

solution_components.name: patient summary report
solution_components.role: Packages the captured symptoms, medication details, and history for consultant review before the first appointment.

solution_components.name: electronic medical record system
solution_components.role: Stores the secured patient summary so clinicians can access it inside the trust's existing workflow.

data_flow: Patients interact with the AI chatbot on The Walton Centre website, answering clinician-prepared questions and adding extra details through natural conversation. The service turns that intake into a structured patient summary report, then sends the report securely into the electronic medical record system so consultants can review the case before the first in-person appointment.
business_outcome: The Walton Centre improved the patient intake experience, gave clinicians earlier visibility into headache cases, reduced appointment time spent on history taking, captured almost all required referral information digitally, and created a more secure and consistent pathway into specialist neurology care.
